description: Dubai has two parallel runway pairs: 12L/30R and 12R/30L. Headings are TRUE (121/301), not magnetic, because no UAE-specific source was found confirming OMDB METAR wind frame, so this pack falls back to the universal ICAO Annex 3 convention that METAR wind is reported relative to true north -- a generic-convention assumption, not a UAE AIP confirmation (docs/OMDB_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md section 1). Pilotnav's true headings (121.4/301.4) and SkyVector's figures read as magnetic (119/299) differ by about 2 degrees, matching a 2015 operator sheet's stated 2 degree East magnetic variation -- the same cross-check pattern used for LSZH. Not checked against the UAE GCAA AIP.
source: Pilotnav.com (true headings, decimal thresholds) cross-checked against an independent web aggregation of Sprinkle.com's figures, 31-10-2026. Not checked against the UAE GCAA AIP.
